errors.description: The fire rating for door D-202 is listed as 45 min in schedule.pdf, but spec.pdf requires a 90-minute fire rating for mechanical room doors.
The flow rate for lavatory L-1 is listed as 5.0 gpm in schedule.pdf, but spec.pdf requires 0.5 gpm aerators maximum for lavatory faucets, indicating a 10x discrepancy.
